summary: Iteration 163 - Extended Integrity Mitigation with BLOCK_NEW_BOTS and FREEZE_SIZING_OVERRIDES actions. All tests pass: 10 unit tests + 7 API integration tests = 17/17 green. Full end-to-end flows verified for both new actions including HTTP 423 gates on /api/bots and /api/admin/guard-shadow/policy/* endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: integrity_mitigation_service.py correctly exports SUPPORTED_ACTIONS frozenset with all 3 actions
are_new_bots_blocked_by_integrity and are_sizing_overrides_frozen_by_integrity helpers return (blocked, detail) tuple for precise 423 payloads
trading_bots.py correctly gates POST /api/bots and PATCH toggle(enabled=true) with 423 when BLOCK_NEW_BOTS active
admin_guard_shadow.py correctly gates /policy/promote and /policy/clear with 423 when FREEZE_SIZING_OVERRIDES active
AlertRuleUpsert validation in admin.py correctly rejects unsupported mitigation actions with 400 and error_code=unsupported_mitigation_action
summarize_integrity_mitigation_state correctly returns block_new_bots and freeze_sizing_overrides boolean flags
Slack notification is best-effort (never blocks activation) - verified by unit test
seed_data_creation: None - test rules (TEST_block_new_bots_rule, TEST_freeze_sizing_rule) were created and deleted during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Integrity Mitigation self-defense layer now supports 3 actions: DEGRADE_TRADING (from iteration 162), BLOCK_NEW_BOTS, and FREEZE_SIZING_OVERRIDES. The summary endpoint returns all flags: active, active_count, risk_multiplier, suppress_strong_signals, block_new_bots, freeze_sizing_overrides, items. HTTP 423 gates are correctly wired: /api/bots POST and toggle(enabled=true) check BLOCK_NEW_BOTS; /api/admin/guard-shadow/policy/promote and /clear check FREEZE_SIZING_OVERRIDES. Invalid mitigation actions are rejected with 400 and error_code=unsupported_mitigation_action. Use ttl_minutes=1 and throttle_hours=0 for fast test cleanup.

unit_tests.details: 10/10 unit tests pass including new tests for BLOCK_NEW_BOTS helper, FREEZE_SIZING_OVERRIDES helper, 3-action summary rollup, Slack-notifier-never-blocks-activation, Slack disabled flag, Slack webhook unset

login_baseline.details: POST /api/auth/login with admin@risedual.ai / RiseDual2026! returns 200, sets cookies, returns user with role=owner

summary_new_flags.details: GET /api/admin/data-integrity/summary returns mitigation object with block_new_bots (bool) and freeze_sizing_overrides (bool) fields. Default both false when nothing active.

block_new_bots_flow.details: Full flow verified: (1) Create rule with action=BLOCK_NEW_BOTS, (2) evaluate-now fires rule, (3) summary.mitigation.block_new_bots=true, (4) POST /api/bots returns 423 with error_code=integrity_block_new_bots, (5) PATCH /api/bots/{id}/toggle with enabled=true returns 423, (6) cleanup via DELETE rule

freeze_sizing_overrides_flow.details: Full flow verified: (1) Create rule with action=FREEZE_SIZING_OVERRIDES, (2) evaluate-now fires rule, (3) summary.mitigation.freeze_sizing_overrides=true, (4) POST /api/admin/guard-shadow/policy/promote returns 423 with error_code=integrity_freeze_sizing_overrides, (5) POST /api/admin/guard-shadow/policy/clear returns 423, (6) cleanup via DELETE rule

bogus_action_validation.details: POST /api/admin/data-integrity/alert-rules with mitigation.action='BOGUS_ACTION' returns 400 with error_code=unsupported_mitigation_action and lists supported actions

no_regression_bots.details: POST /api/bots succeeds (not 423) when no BLOCK_NEW_BOTS mitigation is active

toggle_disabled_always_allowed.details: PATCH /api/bots/{id}/toggle with enabled=false is always allowed regardless of mitigation state (does not return 423)
